what: Stacked photo panels switch every 2.6 seconds — the next panel covers the previous one as a circle (clip-path 0→142%) from the top-right corner in 1.1s expo.inOut, and once fully covered the previous one is hidden. The name text fades off in .3s, changes to the next panel’s name at .6s, and fades on in .4s. Pauses on hover or focus, and rests when off-screen

options.swap: When the name text changes (sec), default .6
options.pause: If none, does not pause on hover
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sections to overlap (two or more) — give data-title and data-href and the name text and link change along with them
options.[data-fx-part=link]: (if present) link covering the whole panel — href changes along with it
options.fx:slide: Event sent to the element on each slide (detail.index)
options.from: Radius at which the circle starts opening (clip-path circle radius), default 0% — set a small dot like 25px to spread from it (brand)
options.zoom: The covering section settles to 1 from this scale with the same length and curve, default 1 (unchanged) — City 1.05
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (If present) a dot button per section — tap to go to that section (ignored while moving) and the current section’s dot gets is-active

use: Work 1
note: If text overlaps the panel, set z-index to 3 or higher. The first-appearance circle reveal is corner-circle-reveal, or supplied separately by the user
